entryResolution.nullPolicy: null definition or unresolved caster returns 0; missing item/instance is rejected before execution

definitionAndPlayerFields.allowedTypeByMode: mode 0 accepts types 6 or 8; nonzero mode accepts types 6 or 7

targetValidation: resolved item/instance record must belong to the caster current room coordinates
caster level at +0x94 must meet definition requirement at +0xBE
current room record is resolved before effect execution
room/configuration restrictions and item-definition compatibility helper 0x00429D40 can reject execution

effectExecution.effectProcessing: effect-specific branches converge on shared completion state and can mark success, failure, chained dispatch, or stop conditions
effectExecution.recursiveDispatch: a chained spell/power can be resolved through 0x00476F7D and recursively dispatched back to 0x00447110, then released through 0x00476F22

resourceAndOutputOrdering: on finalized execution, definition cost +0xBC is subtracted from caster resource +0xBA
half of signed definition requirement +0xF0 is subtracted from caster secondary resource +0x602 where applicable
caster and room output are prepared before flush through 0x0046B170
final host/action notification can run through 0x0044C85F
returnContract: returns a byte-like handled/success flag; hard validation failures return 0

roomAreaBoundary.status: entry and preflight independently bounded for the next pass
roomAreaBoundary.notes: room/area dispatcher begins by resolving the caster, rejecting nulls and invalid definition types, enforcing caster state gates, and resolving class/archetype context

semanticPolicy: Field and effect names are retained as structural contracts unless separately proven by existing MajorMUD evidence.
